---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or integration
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like added?**
E.g. a new tool, a new service integration (Slack, Gmail, Figma, etc.), or a change to an existing tool.

**Why is this useful?**
What workflow does this unblock or simplify?

**Any implementation ideas?**
Optional — if you have thoughts on how it should work (inputs, outputs, API used).
